headline: They Knocked on Its Doors Saying 'If China Builds It, It Will Be Done': The 2,772-Kilometer Railway - Sözcü Newspaper
summary: Indonesia took the lead with China on a 2,772-kilometre railway project. Officials said Russia also views the project favourably, while China has taken a more prominent role.
why: Large cross-border rail infrastructure projects create contracts for contractors and financing for Chinese lenders and builders.
